mentions.name: collab-sqlc
mentions.description: A web-based, self-hosted database client and editor for teams supporting Postgres, DynamoDB, Clickhouse, and Redis. It lets users host and share queries with an auditable query workflow, and is being re-architected from an SQL client (previously a PopSQL alternative) into a broader database client with additional services such as query-as-service and query-as-reporting-job.
